summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of MatchTales World Cup 2026 app. Backend APIs: 100% pass rate (14/14 tests). Frontend: All critical features working including homepage, navigation, group standings tabs, fixtures filters, match detail pages, live second-screen with poll/commentary, newsletter subscription, fan hype wall, theme toggle, search, teams/groups/stories pages, and 404 page.
